Short title and commencement

KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 31st December, 1996]
No. S.Legis.1(9)/96, dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh in hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Karachi
Development Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Article 52-A of K.D.A. Order V of 1957

KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
KARACHI DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Karachi Development Authority Order, 1957
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part I, 31st December, 1996]
No. S.Legis.1(9)/96, dated 31‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh in hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of Article 52‑A
of K.D.A. Order V of 1957.‑‑In the Karachi Development
Authority Order, 1957, in Article 52‑A, in clause (2), the "full‑stop"
at the end shall be replaced by a "semi‑colon" and thereafter,
the following proviso shall be added:‑‑
"Provided
that any amenity plot vesting in the Karachi Transport Corporation may, with
prior approval of Government, be converted to or utilized for any other
purpose. "
